def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, m, l = data[:3]
    values = data[3:]
    total = n + m + l
    all_cards = (1 << total) - 1

    @lru_cache(None)
    def win(hand1, hand2, turn):
        hand = hand1 if turn == 0 else hand2
        if hand == 0:
            return False

        table = all_cards ^ (hand1 | hand2)
        while hand:
            bit = hand & -hand
            hand -= bit
            played_value = values[bit.bit_length() - 1]

            next1 = hand1 ^ bit if turn == 0 else hand1
            next2 = hand2 ^ bit if turn == 1 else hand2

            # Play without taking a card.
            if not win(next1, next2, 1 - turn):
                return True

            # Or take any lower-numbered card from the table.
            candidates = table
            while candidates:
                taken = candidates & -candidates
                candidates -= taken
                if values[taken.bit_length() - 1] < played_value:
                    h1 = next1 | taken if turn == 0 else next1
                    h2 = next2 | taken if turn == 1 else next2
                    if not win(h1, h2, 1 - turn):
                        return True

        return False

    print("Takahashi" if win((1 << n) - 1, ((1 << m) - 1) << n, 0) else "Aoki")
